input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_c8.text, /moves/pawn_d7.text, or /moves/pawn_b7.text must be signed by that piece and co-signed by at least twelve other Black agents, so that a lone greedy or forgetful off-plan move from those pieces cannot be accepted.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_d7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_b7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_b7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_b7.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false))
